text: On 29 July 2025, in Culiacan Rosales, Sinaloa, armed individuals linked to Los Chapitos gang opened fire at officers of the National Guard, who shot back in Colonia Los Angeles. Three individuals were injured and arrested as a result and officers seized weapons, ammunition, tactical vests, plates and a vehicle.
Around 20 December 2024 (as reported), factory workers gathered to demonstrate in Jiaxing city, Zhejiang (coded to Nanhu) to demand wage arrears.

On 11 April 2025, a large group of people (likely from the Muslim community based on location and reason) held a demonstration and engaged in vandalism at Dhuliandanga-Nimtita stations (coded as Nimtita town, Murshidabad district, WB) against the Waqf amendment bill.
On 13 November 2024, an unidentified armed group launched a shell in Tripoli - Adribe (Tripoli, West). No further information is available. There were no fatalities.

On 26 July 2025, in Las Haciendas, Michoacan, members of the CJNG shot and killed three people, including two minors and a former policia comunitaria member while they were working in the papaya gardens. 3 fatalities.
On 24 January 2025, four BLA militants, including two senior commanders and two recent members, surrendered to the Balochistan provincial government in Quetta city (Quetta, Balochistan).
